excerpt: Figure 2 reports that quantum-state preparation and measurement of <psi|sigma_i tensor sigma_j|psi> are performed using a photonic chip. Photon pairs from spontaneous parametric downconversion encode |00>, the state is prepared with thermal phase shifters and one CNOT gate, measured by photon detectors, and detector count rates are passed to the CPU optimizer.
overview: This figure-level evidence ties the algorithm to an implemented physical processor. It establishes which photonic elements perform state preparation, measurement, and feedback, while also delimiting the demonstration to arbitrary two-qubit pure states rather than a large molecular register.
title: Photonic QPU Chip Design
